_source_notes.field_goal_play: Deliberately false. CSRN has no field-goal play-type engine handler yet -- a play_type of "field_goal" would be mis-processed as a punt and canonical_state_service would no-op it. Real Canadian rules do have field goals; flip this to true only when the engine handler ships.
_source_notes.no_yards_halo_yards: 5 = the common restraining-zone radius for a bouncing kick (Wikipedia; matches CFL). A ball caught on the fly is a 15-yard No Yards, not modelled here. Verify the exact amateur value against a current Football Canada rulebook.
_source_notes.try_spot: opp_5 is a PLACEHOLDER. Convert-kick and two-point scrimmage yardage differ by level (e.g. CFL kick from the 25 / two-point from the 3; amateur commonly 5). Verify against a Football Canada rulebook / OFC bylaw before any live Canadian broadcast.
_source_notes.kickoff_spot / free_kick_spot / touchbac: own_35 / own_25 / own_25 follow CFL practice. Amateur levels vary. Verify.
_source_notes.quarter_length_seconds: 900 (15 minutes) follows CFL / U Sports / CJFL. Minor-football levels play shorter quarters. Verify.
_source_notes.penalties: Only the No Yards foul is Canadian-specific here; the rest of the catalogue is inherited from us-nfhs as a rough approximation. Canadian penalty yardages (offside, holding, pass interference as a spot foul, etc.) are NOT verified -- pass a Football Canada rulebook before relying on penalty enforcement for a Canadian game.
